title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have you received an update on ████████ MRI
And i gotta write a column saying who I would pick if I were the Tigers. So who should I pick lol
I don’t have all the info on Miggy yet. You can write that you would take either a good hitting position player or a good pitcher
Figured I’d ask, I picked Bleday
Stupid assignment, I’ve never even seen these guys play

All the names you have heard are the guys. I really don’t know yet. Bleday is one of the names. Rumor has it he is going to the ███████ but I don’t really know for sure. They have been at all his games.

I guess next year’s draft is stacked, though, so you’ll be good
